why_it_moved.text: Before exposure, the Test group already ran ahead on Successful Search Rate, by about the same size as the lift seen during the test.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Most of the lift may come from how users were split between the groups, not from the new ranker.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts were read, so the mechanism is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison that shows the groups were level, or a re-split that fixes the imbalance, would let the lift be read.
A registered explanation for the pre-exposure gap, with evidence, would soften the failed check.
A daily series by days since first exposure would let the novelty check run.
